instruction: Navigate to the Apple icons and images guideline page and copy the 'App Icon' section content. Save this content to a file named 'app_icon_guide.docx' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple icons guideline, extracting App Icon section, and saving to docx. Evaluator verifies file contains at least 200 characters (excluding spaces), confirming successful content extraction with substantial text.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file exists at the required location (/home/user/Desktop/app_icon_guide.docx)
Character count threshold (200 chars) is a reasonable proxy for verifying substantial content was copied
Getter logic correctly extracts character count from docx file (excluding spaces)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict (expected.get('min_chars', 0))
Postconfig properly ensures file is saved before verification
Both getter and metric handle error cases appropriately (return None/0.0)

Minor limitation: Cannot verify the EXACT content is from Apple's 'App Icon' section, but this is impractical without pre-known expected text. Character count threshold is a reasonable practical approach for this type of open-ended content extraction task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding file existence check in getter before attempting to read
Could potentially increase minimum character threshold if typical 'App Icon' section is known to be longer than 200 characters
